content.short: Coin98 provides an all-in-one DeFi platform with essential wallet features in one app.
content.description: Coin98 serves as a versatile DeFi hub that combines a mobile wallet with built‑in trading, enabling storage and trading in a single app. It can function as either a wallet storage app or a trading app, and supports sweep, stake, borrow, lend, invest and earn crypto—all in one place. Developers can issue tokens via the platform. The app has over one million downloads, three million transactions, and 500,000 active users.
content.meta: Coin98 is an all-in-one crypto wallet and DeFi platform with built-in trading. Discover Coin98 and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
